senses.ex: It snows a lot here in the winter.
senses.exPt: Neva muito aqui no inverno.

senses.def: a long thin piece of metal that carries electricity
senses.ex: Don't touch that electric wire.
senses.exPt: Não toque nesse fio elétrico.

senses.def: thin metal in the form of a thread, used to tie or make fences
senses.ex: The garden is surrounded by a wire fence.
senses.exPt: O jardim é cercado por uma cerca de arame.

senses.def: the ability to make good decisions from knowledge and experience
senses.ex: My grandmother is full of wisdom.
senses.exPt: Minha avó tem muita sabedoria.

senses.def: having a lot of knowledge and good judgement
senses.ex: My grandfather was a very wise man.
senses.exPt: Meu avô era um homem muito sábio.

senses.def: sensible; showing good judgement
senses.ex: It would be wise to take an umbrella.
senses.exPt: Seria sensato levar um guarda-chuva.

senses.def: to hope that someone has something good
senses.ex: We wish you a happy birthday!
senses.exPt: Desejamos a você um feliz aniversário!

senses.def: to want something that is not true or not possible now
senses.ex: I wish I had more free time.
senses.exPt: Queria ter mais tempo livre.

senses.def: something you want to happen
senses.ex: Close your eyes and make a wish.
senses.exPt: Feche os olhos e faça um pedido.

senses.def: together with someone or something; using something
senses.ex: I still live with my parents.
senses.exPt: Eu ainda moro com os meus pais.

senses.def: to become dry and weak, and start to die
senses.ex: The flowers withered because nobody watered them.
senses.exPt: As flores murcharam porque ninguém as regou.

senses.def: before a period of time has passed
senses.ex: The package will arrive within three days.
senses.exPt: O pacote vai chegar dentro de três dias.

senses.def: not having or not using something
senses.ex: I can't see anything without my glasses.
senses.exPt: Não enxergo nada sem meus óculos.

senses.def: a person who sees a crime or accident happen
senses.ex: The police are looking for witnesses to the crash.
senses.exPt: A polícia está procurando testemunhas da batida.

senses.def: to see something happen, especially a crime or accident
senses.ex: Several people witnessed the accident.
senses.exPt: Várias pessoas presenciaram o acidente.

senses.def: a man in stories who has magic powers
senses.ex: The old wizard turned the frog into a prince.
senses.exPt: O velho mago transformou o sapo em príncipe.

senses.def: a person who is very good at something
senses.ex: My brother is a wizard with computers.
senses.exPt: Meu irmão é um gênio com computadores.

senses.def: an adult female person
senses.ex: The woman at the desk helped us a lot.
senses.exPt: A mulher no balcão nos ajudou muito.

senses.def: to want to know something; to think about something you are not sure of
senses.ex: I wonder why she didn't come to the party.
senses.exPt: Eu me pergunto por que ela não veio à festa.

senses.def: very good or very pleasant
senses.ex: Thank you for a wonderful evening.
senses.exPt: Obrigado por uma noite maravilhosa.

senses.def: the hard material that trees are made of
senses.ex: The table is made of wood.
senses.exPt: A mesa é feita de madeira.

senses.def: an area of land with a lot of trees, usually smaller than a forest
senses.ex: We went for a walk in the woods.
senses.exPt: Fomos dar uma caminhada no bosque.

senses.def: made of wood
senses.ex: We sat on a wooden bench in the park.
senses.exPt: Sentamos num banco de madeira no parque.

senses.def: the soft hair of sheep, used to make clothes
senses.ex: This sweater is made of wool.
senses.exPt: Este suéter é feito de lã.

senses.def: a unit of language with a meaning
senses.ex: I don't know what this word means.
senses.exPt: Eu não sei o que essa palavra significa.

senses.def: to do a job, usually for money
senses.ex: My mother works at a bank.
senses.exPt: Minha mãe trabalha em um banco.

senses.def: to operate correctly
senses.ex: My phone doesn't work anymore.
senses.exPt: Meu celular não funciona mais.

senses.def: a job, or the things you do in your job
senses.ex: I have a lot of work today.
senses.exPt: Tenho muito trabalho hoje.

senses.def: a person who works, especially for a company
senses.ex: The factory has over two hundred workers.
senses.exPt: A fábrica tem mais de duzentos trabalhadores.

senses.def: connected with your job or the time you spend at work
senses.ex: My working hours are from nine to five.
senses.exPt: Meu horário de trabalho é das nove às cinco.

senses.def: having a job
senses.ex: Many working parents need help with childcare.
senses.exPt: Muitos pais que trabalham precisam de ajuda para cuidar dos filhos.

senses.def: able to work or be used
senses.ex: We need a working computer for the meeting.
senses.exPt: Precisamos de um computador funcionando para a reunião.

senses.def: a period of physical exercise
senses.ex: I do a short workout before breakfast.
senses.exPt: Eu faço um treino curto antes do café da manhã.

senses.def: the place where people work, such as an office or factory
senses.ex: Smoking is not allowed in the workplace.
senses.exPt: Não é permitido fumar no local de trabalho.

senses.def: a meeting where people learn about a subject by doing it
senses.ex: I went to a writing workshop last weekend.
senses.exPt: Fui a uma oficina de escrita no fim de semana passado.

senses.def: the earth and all the people and places on it
senses.ex: I want to travel around the world.
senses.exPt: Eu quero viajar pelo mundo.

senses.def: in all parts of the world
senses.ex: The song became famous worldwide.
senses.exPt: A música ficou famosa no mundo todo.

senses.def: old and damaged because it has been used a lot
senses.ex: His shoes were old and worn.
senses.exPt: Os sapatos dele estavam velhos e gastos.

senses.def: unhappy because you think something bad might happen
senses.ex: My mum gets worried when I come home late.
senses.exPt: Minha mãe fica preocupada quando chego tarde em casa.

senses.def: to keep thinking about problems or bad things that could happen
senses.ex: Don't worry, everything will be OK.
senses.exPt: Não se preocupe, vai dar tudo certo.

senses.def: a problem that makes you feel nervous
senses.ex: Money is my biggest worry right now.
senses.exPt: Dinheiro é minha maior preocupação agora.

senses.def: less good or more bad than something else
senses.ex: The weather is worse today than yesterday.
senses.exPt: O tempo está pior hoje do que ontem.

senses.def: get worse: to become more bad or more ill
senses.ex: My cold is getting worse every day.
senses.exPt: Meu resfriado está piorando a cada dia.

senses.def: the most bad of all
senses.ex: That was the worst film I've ever seen.
senses.exPt: Foi o pior filme que eu já vi.

senses.def: having a particular value in money
senses.ex: This old painting is worth a lot of money.
senses.exPt: Este quadro antigo vale muito dinheiro.

senses.def: useful or enjoyable enough to do
senses.ex: This film is really worth seeing.
senses.exPt: Esse filme realmente vale a pena.

senses.def: worth the time, money or effort you spend
senses.ex: The trip was long, but it was worthwhile.
senses.exPt: A viagem foi longa, mas valeu a pena.

senses.def: deserving respect, attention or support
senses.ex: This idea is worthy of serious attention.
senses.exPt: Esta ideia é digna de atenção séria.

senses.def: used with like to ask or offer something politely
senses.ex: Would you like a cup of tea?
senses.exPt: Você gostaria de uma xícara de chá?

senses.def: an injury to the body, such as a cut
senses.ex: The nurse cleaned the wound on his arm.
senses.exPt: A enfermeira limpou a ferida no braço dele.

senses.def: to cover a present with paper
senses.ex: I still need to wrap her birthday present.
senses.exPt: Ainda preciso embrulhar o presente de aniversário dela.

senses.def: to put something around someone or something
senses.ex: She wrapped a towel around her hair.
senses.exPt: Ela enrolou uma toalha no cabelo.

senses.def: a thin flat bread rolled around a filling
senses.ex: I had a chicken wrap for lunch.
senses.exPt: Comi um wrap de frango no almoço.

senses.def: paper or plastic used to cover something
senses.ex: She tore the wrapping off the present.
senses.exPt: Ela rasgou o embrulho do presente.

senses.def: the joint between your hand and your arm
senses.ex: She wore a silver watch on her left wrist.
senses.exPt: Ela usava um relógio de prata no pulso esquerdo.

senses.def: a watch that you wear on your wrist
senses.ex: My grandfather gave me his old wristwatch.
senses.exPt: Meu avô me deu o relógio de pulso antigo dele.

senses.def: to make words on paper or a screen
senses.ex: I write to my grandmother every month.
senses.exPt: Eu escrevo para a minha avó todo mês.

senses.def: a person whose job is writing books or stories
senses.ex: She wants to be a writer when she grows up.
senses.exPt: Ela quer ser escritora quando crescer.

senses.def: the activity or skill of writing
senses.ex: Writing is harder than reading for many students.
senses.exPt: A escrita é mais difícil que a leitura para muitos alunos.

senses.def: the way a person writes by hand
senses.ex: I can't read your writing, it's too small.
senses.exPt: Não consigo entender sua letra, é muito pequena.

senses.def: expressed in writing, not spoken
senses.ex: We have a written test tomorrow morning.
senses.exPt: Amanhã de manhã temos uma prova escrita.

senses.def: not correct
senses.ex: Sorry, I think you have the wrong number.
senses.exPt: Desculpe, acho que você ligou para o número errado.
